leadText:
(Japanese: トク Toku) is a character of the day who appeared in The Psychic Sidekicks!. He is a resident of Len Town.

He was fishing with his until arrived and used their giant mecha to steal Mr. Mime. Toku commanded Mr. Mime to use on the Gengar robot, but the mirrors on the mecha's eyes deflected the attack and knocked them back. This gave Team Rocket the opportunity to snatch Mr. Mime.

Afterwards, Toku ran into Len Town and warned the townspeople about a giant lurking near Len Town. While Mrs. Bellows's later suffered the same fate as Toku's Pokémon, the alarm led the other residents to seek refuge in their houses before the mecha rolled into town. and decided to take on Team Rocket, and the trio was later defeated after Cherry's used .
